results.title: New free, open-source video editor update brings offline AI subject masking and pro color scopes
results.description: OpenShot 4.0 is now available for Linux, Windows and macOS. The GPLv3 editor gets a color grading view with wheels, curves, scopes and LUT support, a recording view for screen and webcam capture, ten new effects, and subject masking that runs offline.

results.title: This soft robot jumps under infrared light without needing a reset
results.description: US researchers develop soft robots that use infrared light to jump repeatedly without motors, batteries or external resetting.
